mechanics.claim: The ability is a toggle-like transformation between Human Form (ranged, human abilities) and Cougar Form (melee, cougar abilities), not a damaging or defensive effect itself.
mechanics.quote: '''Nidalee''' switches between her '''Human Form''' and '''Cougar Form'''.

mechanics.claim: While in Human Form, landing a Prowl/Hunted mark on a target resets Aspect of the Cougar's cooldown, allowing faster re-entry into Cougar Form to attack again.
mechanics.quote: applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}

mechanics.claim: Cougar Form's sub-abilities (Takedown, Pounce, Swipe) scale their damage based on Aspect of the Cougar's own rank, not independent ranks.
mechanics.quote: '''Cougar Form's''' abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.

mechanics.claim: Switching forms does not count as an ability cast for on-cast trigger effects, so it does not proc things like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
